bob.layout: From 0.9.32 Bob app\Bob.exe is Electron's official electron.exe (devDependencies.electron), only renamed, and Bob's files sit in Bob app\resources\app. Updates never build an exe. electronSha256 (optional) pins the official zip's checksum; otherwise it is checked against Electron's SHASUMS256.txt. electron-builder (dist scripts) is only for making a portable exe by hand.
bob.note: Version = <release>.<patch> from 1.0.0 (formatVersion in src/config.js): 1.0.1 for fixes, 1.1.0 (release 1.1, patch 0) for new features, a letter for unmerged branch work (1.0.1a). Before 1.0 it was 0.9.<build>. build goes up by one with every drop and never resets; the update check compares it. Git tags are v<version>.
